text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: streaming-proxy p99 latency spike in us-east1, autoscaler thrash detected.

morgan: just got the page, I'm oncall

oncall-bot: morgan acknowledged the page

morgan: quick triage - error budget burned on streaming backend, clients seeing long tails. prepping a live mitigation plan.

iris: ETA on hot rollback of recent streaming proto change? we can flip to polling as a temporary fallback.

morgan: doing a controlled feature-flag flip for streaming-responses in us-east1. will move traffic to polling-mode. small canary first.

javier: heads up to support: draft notice to customers that real-time streaming may be degraded and polling fallback will be used; include workaround for realtime UI refresh.

support-sam: drafting now, will post to status and ping top 5 customers. copying note here:

```
We're seeing elevated latency for streaming responses in us-east1. As a temporary mitigation we are switching streaming responses to polling for affected requests. This should stabilize throughput and latency. No data loss expected. Updates to follow.
```

morgan: executing canary now: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/flags/streaming-responses -d '{"region":"us-east1","enabled":false}'`

iris: monitoring metrics. if error-rate jumps >1% rollback immediately.

morgan: canary looks good for 5% of traffic, p95 down ~40%. proceeding to 100% in 3m.

javier: I notified customers A, B, C via email and added note to status page https://status.redwood.example/incident/3830001234

incident-bot: incident created ID INC-2026-3830, severity P2. channel #incidents.

tara: reminders for postmortem: root cause hypothesis, autoscaler config, streaming encoding change, regression test gaps.

morgan: mitigation complete — streaming responses disabled for user-visible push in us-east1, traffic on polling fallback. latency stabilized.

support-sam: customers reported quick improvement. one customer asked for timeline to re-enable streaming; forwarding to product.

iris: safe-to-restore checklist:
- confirm autoscaler steady
- deploy small proxy fix
- run 30m canary

morgan: owners: morgan (oncall), iris (eng), javier (support). I'll keep this thread updated. logging follow-up tasks to project board.

javier: tagging for communications: @product-lina for customer timelines.

morgan: closing the active mitigation. will open a postmortem PSIRT and schedule a 60-min blameless review tomorrow.

support-sam: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
